# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made for the latest published version of ai-bot-access.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for security problems. Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/codevibe-technology/ai-bot-access/security/advisories/new), or email **hello@codevibe.in** with "Security: ai-bot-access" in the subject.

Include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the version affected. We aim to acknowledge reports within 2 working days and will keep you updated until it is resolved.
